name: Digikore Studios Ltd
tagline: Rs ~45 Cr nano-cap VFX outsourcing studio (films/TV/OTT, US-Canada focused) -- claims an FY26 operational turnaround but reports negative TTM EPS, ~0% multi-year revenue growth, ~370-day debtors and, most seriously, ~86-87% of promoter holding pledged; AI disruption to commodity VFX tasks is a live structural threat
business_overview: Digikore Studios provides visual-effects services -- rotoscoping, compositing, object removal, facial tracking -- for films, TV, web series and commercials, mostly for US/Canada clients. It has dabbled in an AI music platform ('I Made a Song'). Listed on the SME platform; has done a rights issue to part-repay debt.
fundamentals_table: ~86.5% of promoter holding pledged (as of Mar-2026)
~Rs 30 - 100; stock down >50% over 1 year, near 52-wk low
~Rs 25 Cr rights issue (Apr-2025) to part-repay debt -- dilutive
fundamentals_narrative: The reported 'operational turnaround' in FY26 is not visible in the fundamentals available: negative TTM EPS, flat multi-year revenue, extremely stretched receivables (~370 days), and a promoter pledge near 87% -- the single biggest concern. On top of company-specific issues, the VFX-outsourcing model faces a genuine structural question: generative AI is automating exactly the repetitive tasks (roto, tracking, object removal) that Indian VFX shops sell. Bulls (HarshVijay) argue AI could instead lift margins if adopted well, but that is unproven. Earlier concalls drew investor complaints that management seemed 'confused about its own numbers' with P&L / cash-flow mismatches.
technical_read: Not pulled. SME-listed, illiquid; down >50% in a year, near 52-week low.
sentiment_summary: Thread of 26 posts. HarshVijay tracked it constructively in 2024 (US contract wins, AI-as-opportunity framing, emailed the company secretary about P&L/cash-flow discrepancies). charan_datt flagged management confusion over its own guidance and unexplained balance-sheet/P&L gaps. Recent post (Sandesh_Patil, Jul-2026) lays out the collapse: stock -50%+ despite a claimed FY26 turnaround, and asks whether it's AI disruption, customer concentration, SME illiquidity, or the high promoter pledge -- explicitly noting the pledge 'could be influencing' the price. No trusted users on the thread; no conviction call.
community_signal: No trusted-user engagement. Retail sentiment has turned clearly negative. No signal / net negative.
